title: Subrogation Recovery Detection

blueprintSignals.name: Fault phrases
blueprintSignals.definition: presence of phrases such as rear-ended, third party driver or defective product in the claim notes
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Phrases need context, since a customer may blame themselves

blueprintSignals.name: Police report match
blueprintSignals.definition: whether an attached report assigns fault to another party
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Reports are not available for every loss

blueprintSignals.name: Counterparty insurer known
blueprintSignals.definition: whether the other party and their insurer are identified
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Data are often incomplete early in the claim

blueprintSignals.name: Days to limitation
blueprintSignals.definition: days remaining to the limitation date for the jurisdiction

engineFeatures.meaning: words and phrases most associated with each class
which conversation or document family a text belongs to
when the text was written, for time-based splits
probability that the top class is right

label: For "Subrogation Recovery Detection": Find paid claims where another party is liable so the insurer recovers money it would otherwise lose. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Past flags are biased to obvious cases, so the model repeats the cases staff already found.
